note: Chippewa NF campground loop in red and white pine in the Norway Beach Recreation Area on the south shore of Cass Lake, 4 mi E of the town of Cass Lake off US 2. The area has sandy beaches, boat ramps, a paved bike trail, interpretive trails and the CCC-built Norway Beach Visitor Center. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov/RIDB read: 50 back-in sites (FS says 55), 26 reservable with 30-75 ft driveways, 24 first come, $21 in 2026 and 2027, weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums, flush + vault toilets, showers, no dump in the rec area, May 22 - Sep 8. Not waterfront confirmed on imagery; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: on Esri imagery the nearest site points (040 at 47.381697,-94.514716; 039 at 47.381716,-94.514403) are about 125 m from Cass Lake's shore through continuous pine forest, and the rest are 150 m or more; rec.gov says 'situated 500 ft. from the banks of Cass Lake'. FS 'Located right on the waters of Cass Lake' describes the recreation area. No change.

FACILITIES conflict: FS 'Potable water is not available at this site.' vs rec.gov 'showers and drinking water are provided' (the same FS line appears on the Mosomo Point page). potable_water written true on rec.gov plus the FS-confirmed showers; a reviewer may prefer to leave it unwritten.

SITES: FS 'No. of Sites 55' vs 50 standard sites in RIDB (024-052 minus 030/032, and 053-078, which RIDB types STANDARD). 50 written. Sites 074 and 075 carry bogus coordinates in the rec.gov search (47.2246,-94.3100, ~25 km SE); excluded from the centroid.
PHONE: none stored -> 218-835-4291 (Blackduck Ranger District; FS page and rec.gov 'please call (218) 835-4291'; RIDB facility_phone has a typo, '21-835-4291').
Pin 47.38041,-94.51661 is ~40 m W of the site centroid 47.38043,-94.51610 (48 sites). No move.

Note cleaned: dropped the field-repeating toilets/showers/reservable text and the unverified 'electric only in the Chippewa loop' remark. Websites current. Status: FS 'Closed for the Season' is the ordinary end of season.

LEADS: none. The other Norway Beach Recreation Area loops are Chippewa Loop (5458) and Wanaki Loop (5457), both in the DB; Cass Lake Loop (rec.gov 233140, 12 sites, centroid 47.37992,-94.52872) is tent-only ('TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC' on all 12) and does not qualify.
